description: Changed-path denominator for the CI dependency-audit cheap-exit (#9871). The dependency-audit job runs the full audit only when the diff touches one of these dependency inputs; otherwise it ends success with 'not applicable: no dependency input changed'. Entries are exact paths, directory prefixes ending in /, or fnmatch globs. A glob without a slash matches only root-level files (e.g. requirements*.txt matches requirements-lock.txt but not scripts/requirements-x.txt); a glob with a slash matches the full repo-relative POSIX path. Added, modified, deleted and renamed (either side) paths all count. Keep this file and scripts/ci/dependency_change_scope.py listed here so changes to the mechanism itself always run the audit.
